verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; pipeline conversion is the priority now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 86 leads at an average cost of $8.14 per lead, but the final 7 days of that window saw a 66.67% drop in leads while spend held nearly flat — meaning cost per lead spiked roughly 179% in that stretch, including three consecutive days with zero leads. The data points to ad creative fatigue on Meta, your sole active paid channel, where the top campaign has been carrying the majority of spend without refreshed creative. Ad creative is being updated this week to break the fatigue pattern and bring lead volume back. Separately, your Google Business Profile held steady at 252 actions and 80 calls this period, which confirms that demand for your practice exists — the paid channel is what needs attention, not the brand itself.
